goal: decompose simple concat, shared/specific regularization, and same-protocol clinical-only control
fixed_split: outputs/phase_m1r/fixed_patient_folds.csv; same five outer folds as M3R
cox: negative Breslow Cox partial likelihood with T_j >= T_i

variant_definitions.S0: clinical encoder and survival head using AGE, SEX, AJCC stage, T/N/M only
variant_definitions.S1: M3R D1: common/specific, adversarial, reconstruction, orthogonality, common concat, clinical
variant_definitions.S3: common encoders + common concat + clinical only
variant_definitions.S4: raw pooled upstream pathology/RNA/CNA concat + clinical
variant_definitions.S5: S1 with clinical context removed from survival head

fairness.S1_S4_shared_upstream: backbone pathology, omics, and clinical encoder initialization byte-identical at same seed/fold
fairness.variant_only: independent stable hashed deterministic seeds isolated with fork_rng

evaluation.global_oof: diagnostic only; never used for selection

training.outer_refit: same seed, full outer train, best inner epoch count
